title: SalesAI S1 Machine-Readable LLM Call Map

call_sites.name: Website Analyzer (Pass A & Pass B)
call_sites.originating_workflow: Phase 3: Candidate Discovery & Website Signal Extraction

sources: Sanitized candidate website HTML / Markdown excerpt

prompt_construction.pass_a: Extract factual company profile: name, services, BIM tooling, company size
prompt_construction.pass_b: Derive sales opportunity signals: pain points, hiring hints, digital maturity
prompt_construction.injection_safeguards: Content truncation and markdown fence isolation

error_handling_and_fallback.retry_policy: Single JSON repair attempt on malformed syntax
error_handling_and_fallback.fallback_mechanism: Deterministic regex and keyword heuristics on raw HTML
error_handling_and_fallback.failure_behavior: Returns partial analysis with error status; scoring continues with baseline score

call_sites.name: Job Posting Analyzer
call_sites.originating_workflow: Phase 4: Hiring Demand & BIM Capability Signal Extraction

sources: Public job listing title, description, and requirements text

prompt_construction.system_instruction: Extract job title, required BIM software (Revit, Archicad, Tekla), experience level, and hiring urgency as strict JSON

error_handling_and_fallback.failure_behavior: Returns JobAnalysisResult with requires_bim=False and logged warning

call_sites.name: Discovery Search Query Generator
call_sites.originating_workflow: Phase 2: Automated Query Generation (Optional LLM Mode)

sources: Target service offering, Italian target regions (Milan, Turin, Rome, etc.), sector taxonomy

prompt_construction.builder: Template expanding industry niches into Google/Bing search syntaxes
prompt_construction.system_instruction: Generate high-intent Italian search queries targeting architectural, engineering, and Scan-to-BIM firms

error_handling_and_fallback.failure_behavior: Executes rule-based combinatorial queries without blocking pipeline

sources: Inbound email body, subject line, sender domain

prompt_construction.builder: InboxClassifier prompt with strict boundary isolation
prompt_construction.system_instruction: Classify inbound reply intent into: interested, not_now, unsubscribe, more_info, referral, out_of_office, other
prompt_construction.injection_safeguards: Content wrapped in <UNTRUSTED_INBOUND_EMAIL> tags with instructions to ignore embedded directives

error_handling_and_fallback.fallback_mechanism: Deterministic regex keyword matching (Unsubscribe detection runs BEFORE LLM)

sources: Customer inquiry, historical outreach draft, verified pyBIM service facts
input_data.pii_classification: High / Customer Confidential PII & Commercial Negotiation

prompt_construction.builder: Grounded prompt injecting verified facts and list of forbidden promises
prompt_construction.system_instruction: Draft polite, professional B2B reply addressing recipient inquiry using ONLY grounded facts. NEVER invent meeting dates, pricing, or team capacity
prompt_construction.injection_safeguards: Explicit prohibition rules and boundary markers

error_handling_and_fallback.retry_policy: Single repair retry on JSON failure
error_handling_and_fallback.fallback_mechanism: Deterministic template replies based on classified intent
error_handling_and_fallback.failure_behavior: Returns fallback template draft; post-generation validator catches any forbidden claims

call_sites.name: Cold Outreach Email Generator
call_sites.originating_workflow: Phase 8: Cold B2B Outreach Draft Generation

sources: OutreachContext: company name, recipient name, role, detected job signals, website evidence
input_data.pii_classification: Medium / B2B Contact Name, Role, and Business Evidence

prompt_construction.system_instruction: Generate highly personalized, concise cold B2B outreach email citing specific company evidence and verified pyBIM capabilities
prompt_construction.injection_safeguards: DraftValidator post-generation checks (no fake links, no unauthorized promises, opt-out footer check)

error_handling_and_fallback.retry_policy: Single repair retry with temperature 0.0 on syntax error
error_handling_and_fallback.fallback_mechanism: Returns (None, error_code, error_message); operator review queue displays error banner
error_handling_and_fallback.failure_behavior: Draft generation fails gracefully; NO email is ever sent automatically
